meta.defaultDescription: Shri Gajanan Seva is a volunteer-run 501(c)(3) non-profit in San Jose, California, offering seva in the tradition of Shri Gajanan Maharaj of Shegaon. Darshan, daily seva, utsav and community drives — all welcome.

common.timezoneNote: Times shown in your local timezone
common.showingEnglish: This page has not been translated into Marathi yet, so it is shown in English.

home.heroEyebrow: Shri Gajanan Seva · San Jose, California
home.heroSubtitle: A volunteer-run seva centre in the tradition of Shri Gajanan Maharaj of Shegaon. Come for darshan, stay for prasad — no appointment, no membership, nothing to arrange first.
home.liveNowBody: Seva is in progress. Join from wherever you are.
home.upcomingTitle: Utsav and seva in the months ahead
home.upcomingBody: Utsav dates follow the tithi, so they move each year. Subscribe once and your calendar stays right.
home.welcomeBody: Nobody will ask you for anything. Here is exactly what happens when you walk in, so it holds no surprises.
home.donateTitle: Your giving is the whole budget
home.donateBody: There is no endowment and no paid staff. Rent, groceries for Mahaprasad and every community drive come from devotees.
home.impactTitle: What your seva did this year
home.connectBody: Announcements go out on WhatsApp first, then the newsletter. Both are quiet — a few messages a month.

about.title: About Shri Gajanan Seva
about.intro: A registered 501(c)(3) non-profit in the Bay Area, run entirely by volunteers.
about.trusteesIntro: Shri Gajanan Seva is governed by a volunteer board. No trustee is paid and no trustee is reimbursed for time.
about.sevaTeamsIntro: Everything that happens at the centre is held by one of these teams. Every one of them is volunteers.
about.transparencyIntro: Where the money comes from, where it goes, and the paperwork that proves it. If something you need is not here, ask and we will publish it.
about.deductibleNote: Donations to Shri Gajanan Seva are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law. Keep your receipt; we also issue an annual statement.

visit.title: Visit the centre
visit.intro: 2350 Paragon Drive, San Jose. Open Thursday, Saturday and Sunday. Everyone is welcome, every time.
visit.firstVisitTitle: Your first visit, step by step
visit.etiquetteIntro: None of this is enforced and nobody will correct you. It is written down only so that you do not have to guess.

dailySeva.title: Daily Seva
dailySeva.intro: The timetable the centre keeps, converted into your timezone so you never have to do the arithmetic.
dailySeva.weeklyNote: The centre is open Thursday, Saturday and Sunday. Online seva runs every day.
dailySeva.jaapIntro: Gan Gan Ganat Bote. The whole practice is these six syllables, repeated.
dailySeva.noSlotsLeft: Today's seva has concluded. The next session is tomorrow.

occasions.title: Occasions
occasions.intro: Utsav, monthly upasana and community seva drives. Utsav dates follow the tithi and move each year, so check before you travel.
occasions.rsvpNote: RSVP helps the kitchen cook the right amount. It is never required to attend.
occasions.subscribeCalendarBody: Add the feed once and every future utsav appears in your calendar automatically, with the dates corrected each year.
occasions.capacityUncapped: No limit — come as you are
occasions.dateToBeConfirmedBody: This date follows the tithi and has not been fixed yet. It is published so you can plan, and will be confirmed nearer the time.
occasions.noneUpcoming: No occasions are on the calendar right now. The newsletter carries new dates as soon as they are fixed.

library.title: Library
library.intro: Every text, recording and newsletter the centre publishes, free to download and free to share.
library.notUploadedYet: This file has not been uploaded yet.
library.videosBody: Aarti, utsav recordings and pravachan, on the centre's YouTube channel.

getInvolved.title: Get involved
getInvolved.intro: The centre runs on seva. There is room for whatever you can give — an hour a month is real help.

donate.title: Donate
donate.intro: Shri Gajanan Seva has no paid staff and no endowment. Everything — the rent, the groceries, the blankets — comes from devotees.
donate.employerMatchBody: Many Bay Area employers match charitable gifts, often one-for-one. If yours does, your donation is worth double for the ten minutes it takes to file. Use these details in Benevity, YourCause or your employer's portal.
donate.onlineBody: Card and bank giving is being set up. Until it is live, Zelle costs the centre nothing and reaches us the same day.
donate.taxNote: Shri Gajanan Seva is a 501(c)(3) organisation. Your gift is tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law.
donate.receiptNote: For a receipt, email us with the date and amount and we will send one.

connect.title: Connect
connect.intro: Announcements, aarti times and utsav dates — on whichever channel you already use.
connect.newsletterBody: One email a month: what is coming up, what the drives collected, and any change to the timetable.
connect.newsletterConsent: Yes, email me the Shri Gajanan Seva newsletter.
connect.newsletterConsentNote: We will send a confirmation email first. Unsubscribe from any issue. We never share or sell the list.
connect.newsletterThanksBody: Check your inbox and confirm the subscription — that last click is what keeps the list clean.
connect.notPublishedYet: This channel is not open yet.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: A volunteer reads every message. Expect a reply within a few days — quicker on a Thursday.
contact.sentBody: Thank you. A volunteer will read this and reply to the address you gave.
contact.failedBody: Something went wrong at our end, not yours. Please email us directly instead.
contact.responseBody: A few days. Thursdays are quickest, because that is when volunteers are at the centre.
contact.desksNote: The form below reaches the same inboxes — it just saves you choosing.
contact.generalBody: Visiting, timings, aarti, upasana, anything about the centre itself.
contact.charityBody: Receipts, employer matching, a missing acknowledgement, or a question about how a fund is spent.
contact.privacyBody: Ask what we hold about you, ask for it to be corrected, or ask us to delete it.

forms.invalidEmail: That does not look like an email address.
forms.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
forms.privacyNote: We use what you send here only to reply to you. See the privacy policy.

footer.nonprofitNote: A registered 501(c)(3) non-profit organisation in California. Run entirely by volunteers.
footer.copyright: Shri Gajanan Seva. All rights reserved.

errors.notFoundBody: The website was rebuilt in 2026 and almost every address changed. Old links mostly redirect themselves, but this one did not. Here is where things live now.
errors.serverBody: This is our fault, not yours. Try again in a moment.
